items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: Bill Connors was on guitar. And it was a spiritual experience. These guys were plugged in to the source.

ctx.x: At Hamilton. That was like 1973 and that did the trick ‘cause there was a, you know these guys were brilliant. Stanley Clarke, Chick, Lenny White, Bill Connors was on guitar. And it was a spiritual experience. These guys were plugged in to the source. And I remember that chapel just like — and I was oh my God man, music can do that, you know lift you up. And it was a lot of improvisation. I remember there was a piano, a grand piano off the stage on the floor and Chick went down to start the second set, he climbed…
I saw them about the same time. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
